component.name: ZChat
component.summary: Native Linux desktop client for WhatsApp Multi-Device

description.p: ZChat is a lightweight GTK4 and Libadwaita client for WhatsApp Multi-Device. It talks to a local background daemon over a Unix socket and stores all chats, messages and media in your own XDG directories.
ZChat is an independent open source project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp LLC or Meta Platforms, Inc.
Photos and videos open in an in-app viewer with the download control overlaid on the thumbnail, attachments render reliably again, and scrolling a chat with media no longer stutters.
Chats open on a single click, the chat list no longer jumps back to the top when one is opened, and media decoding no longer freezes the window.
A sync progress screen that gates the UI until the first full history sync finishes, plus duplicate chat merging.
Emoji picker, find in conversation, and a preferences dialog with theme selection.
Typing indicators, contact presence, and animated WebP stickers.
Sending attachments, read receipts, and RPM and Flatpak packaging.
Replies, forwarding, message deletion, and pinned, archived and muted chats.
